54/G.goal: Explain how VR resource optimization is grounded in client-side computer graphics and the rendering and display of raster color images.
54/G.achieves: It prepares the learner to understand the resource requirements and optimization approaches for building virtual reality systems with confidence.

54/O1.goal: Explain what virtual reality resource optimization means and why it requires understanding client-side computer graphics image representation and synthesis.
54/O1.achieves: It gives the learner the conceptual frame needed to follow later discussions of virtual reality resource requirements and optimization.

54/O2.goal: Explain how generic graphics systems render color images by using their hardware components, vector or raster scanning, and raster frame-buffer refreshing.
54/O2.achieves: It gives the learner the display and rendering basis needed to evaluate the computational and hardware demands of virtual reality experiences.
